content:
We have search results. The first search gave several templates. We need the template that when applied to the molecule reproduces the Diels-Alder reaction (retro step). The description: forward reaction is Diels-Alder forming six-membered ring, bonds broken: C=C to C-C (two bonds). So retrosynthetic step would break the cyclohexene ring into diene and dienophile.

We have initial molecule: COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O. This looks like a bicyclic? Actually it's a cyclohexene with a lactone? Let's see.

We need to find a template that matches this molecule and is a Diels-Alder retro template. The search we did with bonds broken/formed gave some templates, but not necessarily Diels-Alder. The first result (reaction_id 171837) has retro_smarts_template: '[C:1]-[C;H0;D3;+0:2](=[O;H0;D1;+0:9])-[CH2;D2;+0:3]-[C:4]-[C:5](=[O;D1;H0:6])-[#8:7]-[C;D1;H3:8]>>[C:1]-[CH;D2;+0:2]=C-[CH2;D2;+0:3]-[C:4]-[C:5](=[O;D1;H0:6])-[#8:7]-[C;D1;H3:8].[OH2;D0;+0:9]'

That seems like a retro-aldol? Not Diels-Alder.

We need a template that splits a cyclohexene into diene and dienophile. Let's search with functional_groups_broken maybe "C-C double bonds" etc. The Diels-Alder breaks two C=C bonds (the diene and dienophile double bonds become single bonds). So forward reaction forms two C-C bonds and breaks two C=C bonds. In retrosynthesis, we need a template that breaks two C-C bonds and forms two C=C bonds? Actually retro Diels-Alder: you break the cyclohexene ring into diene and dienophile, forming two double bonds. So the template would have bonds_broken: "6-6" maybe? Not sure.

Better to search with bonds_broken: ["6-6","6-6"]? The tool expects list of bond types, not duplicates. Could specify bonds_broken ["6-6"] and bonds_formed ["6-6"]? Already did that first search, got some templates but not Diels-Alder.

Maybe need to search with functional_groups_broken: ["C-C double bonds"]? Actually forward reaction forms C-C bonds, so broken in forward are C-C double bonds (i.e., alkenes). The functional group list includes "C-C double bonds". So we can set functional_groups_broken ["C-C double bonds"] and functional_groups_formed maybe none. Let's try.
